quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Comparing your own news to everyone else's and feeling like it falls short points to a specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Wishing you had something to share, after hearing everyone else's exciting updates, is a common form of disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone at the reunion had big news — new jobs, new babies, trips abroad. I sat there wishing I had something to add.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Five years of work confirmed all at once tends to bring a strong, positive rush.
quests.explanation: Getting the exact result you've worked five years to prove is a clear, well-earned cause of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The research results just came back — exactly what we predicted. After five years, we finally have our proof.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A light appearing in a house everyone assumed was empty points to a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: Noticing a sign of life in a place you thought was empty is a natural spark of curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: That old house next door has been empty since I moved onto this street. Someone was upstairs last night — I saw the light.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Effort that goes completely unacknowledged tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Putting in extra effort that goes entirely unnoticed, especially at a moment like a promotion, is a common trigger for anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I stayed late every night this month, and nobody even mentioned it when the promotion was announced.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching the same information presented four times in one week tends to bring one clear reaction.
quests.explanation: Sitting through the same material for a fourth time in one week is a straightforward cause of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: This documentary covers exactly the same material as the three others I watched on the same topic this week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Stepping off a train into a reunion after two years apart tends to bring a very warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Seeing your whole family waiting for you after two years apart is a simple, powerful happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I got off the train and my whole family was standing on the platform. I hadn't seen them in two years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeating reassurance to yourself, and having it fail, points to a familiar feeling.
quests.explanation: Trying to talk yourself out of fear before a first flight, without much success, is a natural sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've never flown before and we board in an hour. I keep telling myself it's perfectly safe — it's not working.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Making an obvious, public mistake about someone's identity tends to bring a hot, uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Getting a colleague's name wrong in front of everyone is a classic, everyday cause of embarrassment.
quests.textToSpeak: I called my new manager by his predecessor's name in front of the whole office. He's worked here for five years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Comparing today's challenge to many past successes points to a particular mindset.
quests.explanation: Comparing today to many past successful runs is a clear expression of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've run this exact route in every kind of weather. I'll finish today's race just like all the others.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Seeing an empty space where a child's things used to be points to a gentle, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Seeing an empty peg where your child's things used to hang is a small, quiet marker of time passing — and it brings sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: The school asked parents to collect their child's artwork for the year. I walked past her old peg and it was already empty.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two weeks of holding your breath, finally let out, points to a specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Finally hearing good news after two weeks of worry is exactly what relief feels like.
quests.textToSpeak: The test results came back clear. I've been holding my breath for two weeks waiting for that call.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Beating a goal well ahead of schedule tends to bring a strong, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: Reaching a target early with time to spare is a clear, satisfying cause of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: I hit my target early this quarter, and we've still got two months to go. These numbers are outstanding.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long, dry document with a tight deadline tends to bring one familiar reaction.
quests.explanation: A two-hundred-page manual due by Friday is exactly the kind of task that produces boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The new employee handbook is two hundred and forty pages long, and we're required to read all of it by Friday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being blamed for someone else's clear error tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Being asked to prove someone else's obvious mistake is a common and understandable trigger for anger.
quests.textToSpeak: You had my ticket details. You processed the refund to the wrong account, and now you want me to prove it was your mistake?

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small act of care from a neighbor tends to bring a warm, appreciative feeling.
quests.explanation: A neighbor's simple, thoughtful gesture during a hard week is a quiet, genuine source of happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: She knocked on my door with soup when I was sick all week. That's just the kind of person she is.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An act of generosity nobody expected tends to bring a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: An unexpected act of generosity, this large and this public, is a natural cause of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The man who ran the local shop for thirty years retired and gave the building to the neighborhood, free of charge.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A cracking voice minutes before a high-stakes presentation is a physical sign of a specific feeling.
quests.explanation: A cracking voice before presenting to senior leadership is a very physical, very common sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: The panel includes the CEO and three board members. My presentation is in ten minutes and my voice is already cracking.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Sending a strongly worded message to the wrong person entirely tends to bring an uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Sending an angry complaint to a completely innocent company is an everyday, very relatable cause of embarrassment.
quests.textToSpeak: I wrote a long complaint email about terrible service, then realized I'd sent it to the wrong company entirely.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A proud moment shadowed by someone who isn't there to see it points to a bittersweet feeling.
quests.explanation: A happy milestone that someone important isn't there to witness carries a real, quiet sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: She passed her driving test on the first try. I just wish Dad could have been there — he always said she could do it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Deep preparation combined with total clarity about your own goal points to a specific mindset.
quests.explanation: Knowing exactly what you want, backed by real preparation, is a clear expression of confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I've read every negotiation book in the library. When I walk into that room, I know exactly what I want.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Losing something valued for a replacement that isn't even being used tends to bring a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Losing a community space for an unused replacement, without any consultation, is a common cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: They removed the community garden to build a car park that still isn't even in use. Nobody was consulted.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: News that ends a four-year wait tends to bring one overwhelming, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: A long-awaited call about adopting a child, after four years of waiting, is a deep and simple happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We've been trying to adopt for four years. The agency called this morning — there's a little girl who needs a home.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long, drawn-out event with no real content tends to bring one familiar reaction.
quests.explanation: Three hours of speeches nobody asked for is a relatable, everyday cause of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: Another awards ceremony with a three-hour running time and speeches nobody actually asked for.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Hard work not producing the result you expected tends to bring a specific, deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: Working harder than usual and still barely passing is a common, relatable form of disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I studied harder for this exam than any other, and I still only just scraped a pass. I don't understand what went wrong.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A quiet, repeated act with no explanation tends to draw out one particular feeling.
quests.explanation: A small, unexplained ritual repeated every month naturally makes people curious about who's behind it.
quests.textToSpeak: Every month, someone leaves a single white flower on the old bench by the river. Nobody knows who, or why.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A place tied to years of memories no longer belonging to your family points to a certain feeling.
quests.explanation: Losing a home full of shared memories to new owners is a quiet, common form of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: We used to spend every Christmas at that house. This year, it belongs to someone else.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long-held goal finally becoming real tends to bring a strong, positive rush.
quests.explanation: Twelve years of quiet work leading to a real gallery show is a well-earned cause of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: After twelve years of painting in my spare room, a real gallery is finally going to show my work.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Delaying a difficult conversation all week points to a specific kind of dread.
quests.explanation: Putting off a hard conversation all week, right up until it has to happen, is a familiar sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I need to tell my parents something tonight that they're not going to take well. I've been putting it off all week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Expecting bad news and getting approval instead points to a specific, calming feeling.
quests.explanation: Getting approval after fully expecting a rejection is exactly what relief feels like.
quests.textToSpeak: The insurance company finally approved the claim. I was so sure they'd find some reason to say no.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Seeing your child proud and settled in a new role tends to bring a warm feeling of your own.
quests.explanation: Seeing your child happy and proud on their first day is a simple, warm happiness of your own.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter texted a photo from her first day at her new job. She looked so proud standing there in her new badge.
